light_description: Handmade overdrive based on the distortion channel of an Overdrive Special concept, emphasizing a thick focused midrange and long sustain; also usable as a clean booster.
White-finish TSpecial presentation documented by AKG Sound Design; retained as a finish/production variant of TSpecial rather than a separate conceptual model.
Limited TSpecial version using a NOS JRC4558 and Version 2 internal design; documented as a four-unit limited edition.
Black-finish counterpart to the limited JRC4558 TSpecial presentation; retained as a documented variant rather than a new conceptual model.
Transparent-style fuzz designed by AKG Sound Design, also usable as a clean booster, with strong EQ range.
White-finish Magnus presentation documented in the current AKG lineup; retained as the standard Magnus model family.
Limited Germanium-transistor Magnus variant using NTE103A; lower-gain version documented by AKG Sound Design.
Limited Germanium-transistor Magnus variant using NTE103B; higher-gain version documented by AKG Sound Design.
